name: CurlShot API
description: Screenshot API that renders a URL, HTML or Markdown in a real browser and returns a PNG, JPEG, WebP, PDF or scrolling video (MP4, WebM, GIF).
notes: Public docs, an OpenAPI 3.1 description, llms.txt and a remote MCP server (https://curlshot.com/api/mcp) make it usable by AI agents. Free plan with 100 screenshots a month and no card; failed renders and cache hits are not counted.
